overview: Opinionated tweaks to the crosshair, to whatever it is pointing at, and to what happens when it is pointing at nothing.
Client-side only. Nothing needs to be installed on the server.

1.2.0: Other mods can give their own items a crosshair: throwing knives take the throwable circle, and a camera brings a viewfinder of its own. Each such item gets its own policy and shape in the mod menu, starting from what its mod suggested.
This works on servers too: a Pandorical server mod's items bring their crosshair with them, without the mod installed on your side.
1.1.2: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
1.1.1: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
1.1.0: Every shape setting shows the shape beside its name in the mods menu.
The scope reticle's drop marks sit lower and further apart.
1.0.1: A block in one hand no longer jumps the queue ahead of a bow, food or a pearl in the other.
Where the block would land somewhere other than the outline says, there is no reacharound.
A shield only takes the crosshair when a click would actually raise it.
F3's crosshair stands this one down.
The config rewrites itself when a key is missing, so a new setting is never hidden.
1.0.0: Reacharound placement: stand at an edge, look ahead, and the next block goes out in front.
An outline shows where it will land before you click. No more looking down to bridge.
Plus a styleable selection box and a set of crosshairs to pick from.
